nodes.label: Sentinel (personal investment intelligence agent)
nodes.rationale: Single-user, approval-gated, built from a frozen PRD. Advisory only — no trading paths, no autonomous execution, no multi-tenancy.

nodes.label: Phase 0 — data layer and daily digest
nodes.rationale: Delivers net worth, liabilities, allocation drift, concentration, buckets, milestones, RSU projection and a freshness verdict. DoD: digest figures agree with Kite / INDmoney / Fidelity within plus-or-minus 1%.

nodes.label: Phase 1 ("Think") — recommendation engine
nodes.rationale: FR-10 through FR-15 built on the existing schema. The agent scores, sizes, gates and scores-after-the-fact entirely on paper; nothing executes and there is no code path that could.

nodes.label: FR-31 staleness gate
nodes.rationale: Every source carries a freshness limit. You cannot act on what cannot be valued today, so a lapsed source withdraws the names that depend on it rather than letting them be scored on old data.

nodes.label: blockedInstruments (valuation-input blocking)
nodes.rationale: Blocks on valuation inputs, not just the portfolio source: the position's own portfolio feed, FX for anything non-INR, NAV for funds, prices for equity/ETF/bond, fundamentals for equity. A blocked name is not scored at all, and an open recommendation raised before the lapse is withheld and listed under staleness.

nodes.label: Section 6 quality gate (fail-closed)
nodes.rationale: ROCE, five-year FCF, D/E with a finance-sector waiver and screener red flags, all fail-closed on an unknown — an absent metric is a fail, never an assumed pass.

nodes.label: Composite score (valuation 30 / trend 30 / earnings 20 / fit 20)
nodes.rationale: Banded HIGH / MEDIUM / WATCH / NONE; only MEDIUM-or-better becomes an FR-11 recommendation.

nodes.label: FR-11 recommendation object (primary + exactly two alternates)
nodes.rationale: A1 is the same intent through a different instrument or the broad-index route; A2 is a different intent defaulting to doing nothing. Each carries a thesis under 150 words and at least one IPS clause that must actually exist in src/config/ips-v1.md — forcing the alternates keeps a single recommendation from reading as the only option.

nodes.label: FR-12 action caps
nodes.rationale: Four per calendar month and no repeat BUY on a name inside twelve months, overridable only by an IPS spec change, a material adverse falsification, or an owner directive.

nodes.label: suppressed_actions (capped actions are logged, never dropped)
nodes.rationale: A capped action is written to suppressed_actions and shown in the report so the owner can see the engine wanted to act and the cap said no.

nodes.label: IPS v1 verbatim text
nodes.rationale: PRD sections 3.1-3.10 stored verbatim and rendered via renderIps. A paraphrase at minus-20% drawdown is a product failure — the exact wording is the binding contract when it matters most.

nodes.label: IPS 3.7 twelve-month minimum hold and its overrides
nodes.rationale: Only thesis falsification, a red-flag event or a hard-cap breach override the hold. Other exit triggers (sustained underperformance, a better alternative) are still surfaced flagged blockedByMinimumHold, so the owner sees the engine wanted out and the policy said wait.

nodes.label: funded_status unreadable by sizing or risk
nodes.rationale: Deliberately isolated so no catch-up behaviour can emerge: knowing it is behind must never make the agent size bigger. Enforced by an architecture test rather than convention.

nodes.label: Branded bigint paise/cents (no floats)
nodes.rationale: Every money path uses branded bigint minor units; a float anywhere in a money path is a correctness bug, and the brand makes it a type error instead.

nodes.label: No trading paths / no autonomous execution
nodes.rationale: No F&O, intraday, leverage or loan-against-securities. These are absent code paths, not disabled features — there is no override flag, and every order needs fresh human approval.

nodes.label: GSEC_YIELD_PCT (owner-supplied, never invented)
nodes.rationale: There is no ingestion source for the 10Y G-sec yield, so it is a required caller input. Blank means 'not configured' and the signal review states it did not run — never 0%.

nodes.label: What the engine will not invent
nodes.rationale: The G-sec yield, a cost basis it cannot read, a tax figure, a rating action, and a hit-rate from fewer than 20 evaluations in a bucket. Unknown cost basis is NULL, never 0; an unknown is never rendered as Rs 0.

nodes.label: pnpm sync
nodes.rationale: Syncs holdings from INDmoney, FX, NSE bhavcopy plus index, and AMFI NAVs.

nodes.label: pnpm digest
nodes.rationale: Composes and sends the daily digest via Telegram; DRY_RUN=1 prints to stdout and never calls Telegram, so placeholder credentials suffice locally.

nodes.label: pnpm report (weekly deep report FR-51)
nodes.rationale: Five sections: signal review, watchlist changes, recommendation pipeline, staleness plus blocked names, scoring and narrative. `--as-of YYYY-MM-DD` reproduces a past week.

nodes.label: Plus-or-minus 1% reconciliation DoD
nodes.rationale: Per-account digest figures must agree with Kite, INDmoney and Fidelity NetBenefits within 1% before the system is trusted — an external ground truth rather than internal self-consistency.

nodes.label: Phase 1 provisioning items unverified against live sources
nodes.rationale: NSE bhavcopy and index URLs are unverified against live NSE, AMFI is fixture-verified only, the holidays table is empty so only weekends are skipped, and GSEC_YIELD_PCT awaits owner input. Each fails loudly, but loudly still means a week of no data.

hyperedges.label: FR-31 staleness blocking chain (source lapse to withheld recommendation)
